module: pdq/present_windows — App Share on G: (directory + explicit NTFS ACL + SMB share)
status: P0 rev3 2026-07-27 (folded Codex P2 r2 — Director ratified SKIP_REVERT idempotency); awaiting Codex P2 r3
goal: First real pdq role logic: create the PDQ Deploy repository (App Share) directory on the G: (PDQSHARE) disk, apply an EXPLICIT NTFS ACL (Administrators + SYSTEM Full, BUILTIN\Users R&X — none relied on via inheritance), and SMB-share it for Central Server multi-admin console access. Bundled per Director (win_file + win_acl + win_share).
why: The PDQ Deploy repository is the install-source folder; a Central Server shared by multiple admin consoles requires it as a UNC SHARE, and it lives on the dedicated G: PDQSHARE disk (windows_disk_manager provisions G: earlier in the play). PDQ docs: repository R/W by the Background Service User; NTFS restricted to admins.
directorDecisions: 2026-07-27: (a) bundle the SMB share with dir+ACL (one piece); (b) folder = G:\AppRepo, share name = AppRepo.

contract.path: App Share dir = '{{ __share_drive__ }}:\{{ config.repository.dir_name }}' where __share_drive__ = config.data_disks.share.drive_letter (G, a BLOCK-VAR — Codex P2 #8, no set_fact) and repository.dir_name defaults 'AppRepo' -> G:\AppRepo. SMB share name = config.repository.share_name (default 'AppRepo').
contract.acl: win_acl grants THREE EXPLICIT ACEs on G:\AppRepo, each inherit=true (InheritanceFlags ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit; propagation to this folder + subfolders + files) — NONE relied on via root inheritance (Codex P2 #2/#4): (1) BUILTIN\Users ReadAndExecute (org convention — RESTART §6 U1: everyone here is an admin; an explicit Users R&X ACE means an Explorer elevation never STAMPS a personal ACE that becomes a stale SID); (2) BUILTIN\Administrators FullControl; (3) NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM FullControl (the PDQ background service + product run as/under SYSTEM-adjacent contexts). state=present is ADDITIVE — it PREVENTS a future personal-ACE stamp on this clean role-created dir; it does NOT remove a pre-existing personal/stale ACE (Codex P2 #3 — claim narrowed to prevention-on-clean-managed-dir).
contract.share: win_share name=AppRepo, path=G:\AppRepo, rule_action='set' (Codex P2 #1 — closed, intentional permission set, no stale share ACEs), full=['Administrators'] (Central Server admin consoles + the Background Service User, a local admin per P05, get R/W via admin membership), caching_mode='none' (repository files are pulled live, not offline-cached). NO Users share grant (Codex P2 #6): PDQ default is PUSH copy (the service user reads the local repo + pushes to targets — targets never touch the share); the share exists here for multi-admin Central Server console access, NOT Pull-copy.
contract.deferred: Pull Copy Mode (Codex P2 #6): DEFERRED. PDQ's Deploy User need NOT be a local admin, and Pull Copy authenticates targets to the UNC share as the Deploy User requiring share R/W. If Pull is later enabled, a dedicated Deploy-User/group R/W grant (share + NTFS) is added then — NOT assumed here. P03 configures the default Push posture. Also DEFERRED: PDQ's repository-inheritance-protection + NT AUTHORITY\INTERACTIVE removal (their security best-practice hardening) -> a separate hardening piece; P03 does not claim that posture.
contract.entitlement: P03 establishes the GROUP-based entitlement (Administrators Full); P05 later makes the Background Service User ELIGIBLE by adding it to local Administrators. P03 cannot prove effective access AS that account (it does not exist yet) — Codex P2 #5.

smallestStep: In pdq/tasks/present_windows.yml replace the no-op body with a block whose vars derive __share_drive__/__repo_dir__ (block-var): (1) win_file state=directory G:\AppRepo; (2) win_acl x3 explicit inherited ACEs (Users R&X, Administrators Full, SYSTEM Full); (3) win_share AppRepo rule_action=set full=Administrators caching=none. Add defaults: repository.dir_name='AppRepo', repository.share_name='AppRepo'.
research: PDQ Deploy repository (docs.pdq.com/current-version/Deploy/repository-file.htm + repository.htm): UNC path REQUIRED for a repository shared by multiple admins under Central Server (our case) AND for Pull Copy; default %PUBLIC%\...\PDQ Deploy\Repository. PDQ security best practices (help.pdq.com/43238981958299): protect repository folder inheritance, restrict to admins, remove insecure NT AUTHORITY\INTERACTIVE — noted as a DEFERRED hardening piece.

PDQ credentials (help.pdq.com/115002510472): Background Service User adds/retrieves repo files (R/W); the Deploy User authenticates to targets and (Pull mode only) to the UNC share (R/W) and need NOT be a PDQ-server local admin — hence Pull deferred, not assumed.

windows-wsus U1 (RESTART §6 / style §4c): explicit BUILTIN\Users ReadAndExecute (allow, inherit) on role-created app dirs; win_acl type=allow inherit=true. ansible.windows win_file/win_acl/win_share are idempotent.
invariants: App Share path derived from config.data_disks.share.drive_letter + config.repository.dir_name via a BLOCK-VAR (no hardcoded G:, no set_fact — Codex P2 #8).

THREE explicit inherited NTFS ACEs (Users R&X, Administrators Full, SYSTEM Full) — nothing relied on via inheritance (Codex P2 #2); each IsInherited=false, InheritanceFlags ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit.
win_share rule_action=set (closed set), full=Administrators, caching=none; NO Users share grant (Push default; Pull deferred — Codex P2 #6).
Runs AFTER windows_disk_manager provisions G: (play role order); no PDQ install dependency (repository-repoint is a later post-install piece). Loader/validate/playbook/disk-manager untouched.
Claim scoped: prevention-of-personal-ACE-stamp on a clean managed dir, NOT stale-ACE normalization nor the PDQ inheritance-hardening posture (both deferred).

scopeLock.forbidden: tasks/main.yml (loader), tasks/validate.yml, windows_disk_manager (framework), pdq.yml (playbook), .framework-pin, any other file

proofs: POSITIVE E2E (live pdq-dev, REVERT-FIRST): compose -> windows_disk_manager provisions G: -> pdq creates the App Share. FALSIFIABLE assertions (pass/fail, not just display — Codex P2 #10): Test-Path G:\AppRepo == true; (Get-Acl G:\AppRepo).Access -> a BUILTIN\Users ACE with FileSystemRights ReadAndExecute, IsInherited=false, InheritanceFlags='ContainerInherit, ObjectInherit'; a BUILTIN\Administrators FullControl explicit ACE; a NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM FullControl explicit ACE; NO NT AUTHORITY\INTERACTIVE ACE was ADDED by this role; (Get-SmbShare AppRepo).Path == G:\AppRepo and CachingMode == None; Get-SmbShareAccess AppRepo -> exactly {Administrators Full}, no Everyone/Users entry.

IDEMPOTENCY (Director-RATIFIED method 2026-07-27, Codex P2 r2 #11 resolved): after the revert-first positive converge, re-run with SKIP_REVERT=1 against the converged state -> win_file/win_acl/win_share all changed=0, recap failed=0. SKIP_REVERT is hereby the approved idempotency-proof mechanism (composition testing AND idempotency re-runs), formalizing the windows-wsus ledger practice — NOT a lifecycle violation.
NEGATIVE (unchanged gate): the pdq validate (license/service-account) still fails the run when those inputs are empty (regression check).
judgementCalls: Explicit Administrators Full + SYSTEM Full (not inherited) — consistent with distrusting inheritance for the Users ACE (Codex P2 #2).

Defer Pull Copy (Codex P2 #6): configure the default Push posture (share = Administrators Full for Central Server admin consoles); a Deploy-User R/W grant is added only if Pull is later enabled. Do not assume the Deploy User is a local admin.
Defer the PDQ repository inheritance-hardening + INTERACTIVE removal to a separate hardening piece; narrow P03's stale-ACE claim to prevention-on-clean-dir.
win_share rule_action=set (closed set); caching=none; block-var path derivation (no set_fact).
blastRadius: Low — one directory + 3 NTFS ACEs + one SMB share on the already-provisioned G: disk. No PDQ install, no Pull/hardening config. Idempotent, reversible.
risk: Low. The SMB share exposes G:\AppRepo (Administrators Full only, no Everyone/Users share access; NTFS admins+SYSTEM Full, Users R&X). Network reachability is governed by the host firewall/network layer, not this piece. No secrets.
